title: 3D subdivided icosahedron - canvas
summary: This visualization presents an iterated icosahedron — a geometric construction that begins with a regular icosahedron and recursively subdivides its triangular faces. Same example as the 3d-subdivided-icosahedron example, but rendered in canvas instead of SVG which gives a considerable speed-up.
